# Sakuya Cheat Menu Pro - Block 3 Character helper effects

sakuya_b3_clear_all_marked_character_effect = {
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            any_scope_character = {
                has_variable = sakuya_mark_character_target
            }
        }
        every_scope_character = {
            limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_character_target }
            remove_variable = sakuya_mark_character_target
        }
    }
    every_character_in_exile_pool = {
        limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_character_target }
        remove_variable = sakuya_mark_character_target
    }
    every_country = {
        limit = { is_player = yes }
        remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_cached
    }
}

sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_character_effect = {
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            any_scope_character = {
                has_variable = sakuya_mark_character_target
            }
        }
        every_scope_character = {
            limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_character_target }
            save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
            root = { set_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found }
        }
    }
    every_character_in_exile_pool = {
        limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_character_target }
        save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
        root = { set_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = {
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
    every_country = {
        limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_country_target }
        save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
        root = { set_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_country_culture_resolve_player_marked_state_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_scope
    clear_saved_scope = sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_region_scope
    if = {
        limit = { any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state } }
        random_scope_state = {
            limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
            save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_scope
            state_region = { save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_region_scope }
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_country_culture_resolve_marked_country_state_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_scope
    clear_saved_scope = sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_region_scope
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
            scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = {
                any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
            }
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = {
            random_scope_state = {
                limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
                save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_scope
                state_region = { save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_region_scope }
            }
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_country_culture_add_saved_to_dest_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope
            scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope = {
                NOT = { country_has_primary_culture = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope }
            }
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope = {
            add_primary_culture = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_country_culture_remove_saved_from_dest_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope
            scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope = {
                country_has_primary_culture = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope
                any_primary_culture = {
                    NOT = { this = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope }
                }
            }
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope = {
            remove_primary_culture = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_country_culture_add_marked_country_to_player_effect = {
    save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = {
            every_primary_culture = {
                save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope
                root = { sakuya_b3_country_culture_add_saved_to_dest_effect = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_country_culture_add_player_to_marked_country_effect = {
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = { save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope }
        every_primary_culture = {
            save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope
            root = { sakuya_b3_country_culture_add_saved_to_dest_effect = yes }
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_country_culture_remove_marked_country_from_player_effect = {

sakuya_b3_country_culture_add_player_marked_state_to_player_effect = {
    save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_dest_scope
    sakuya_b3_country_culture_resolve_player_marked_state_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_region_scope }
        every_country = {
            every_scope_culture = {
                save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_state_region_scope = { is_homeland = scope:sakuya_b3_country_culture_source_scope } }
                    root = { sakuya_b3_country_culture_add_saved_to_dest_effect = yes }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_apply_player_agitator_slots_modifier_effect = {
    remove_modifier = sakuya_cheat_b3_country_agitator_slots_player
    if = {
        limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value } }
        add_modifier = {
            name = sakuya_cheat_b3_country_agitator_slots_player
            multiplier = root.var:sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value
        }
    }
    sakuya_b3_refresh_agitator_slots_active_effect = yes
}

sakuya_b3_apply_marked_agitator_slots_modifier_effect = {
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = {
            remove_modifier = sakuya_cheat_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value }
                add_modifier = {
                    name = sakuya_cheat_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked
                    multiplier = var:sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value
                }
            }
        }
    }
    sakuya_b3_refresh_agitator_slots_active_effect = yes
}

sakuya_b3_refresh_agitator_slots_active_effect = {
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_active
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                has_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value
                AND = {
                    has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
                    exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
                    scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = { has_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value }
                }
            }
        }
        set_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_active
    }
}

sakuya_b3_apply_player_agitator_slots_modifier_delta_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { root = { NOT = { has_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value } } }
        root = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value value = 0 } }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value add = $DELTA$ } }
    if = {
        limit = { root.var:sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value = 0 }
        root = { remove_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value }
    }
    sakuya_b3_apply_player_agitator_slots_modifier_effect = yes
}

sakuya_b3_apply_marked_agitator_slots_modifier_delta_effect = {
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value } }
                set_variable = { name = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value value = 0 }
            }
            change_variable = { name = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value add = $DELTA$ }
            if = {
                limit = { var:sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value = 0 }
                remove_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value
            }
        }
    }
    sakuya_b3_apply_marked_agitator_slots_modifier_effect = yes
}

sakuya_b3_clear_all_agitator_slots_modifier_effect = {
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_active
    every_country = {
        remove_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_player_value
        remove_variable = sakuya_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked_value
        remove_modifier = sakuya_cheat_b3_country_agitator_slots_player
        remove_modifier = sakuya_cheat_b3_country_agitator_slots_marked
    }
}

sakuya_b3_character_self_apply_modifier_effect = {
    remove_modifier = $MOD$
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                has_variable = $VAR$
            }
        }
        add_modifier = {
            name = $MOD$
            multiplier = root.var:$VAR$
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_character_self_change_modifier_delta_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                NOT = { has_variable = $VAR$ }
            }
        }
        root = {
            set_variable = { name = $VAR$ value = 0 }
        }
    }
    root = {
        change_variable = { name = $VAR$ add = $DELTA$ }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { root.var:$VAR$ = 0 }
        root = {
            remove_variable = $VAR$
        }
    }
    sakuya_b3_character_self_apply_modifier_effect = {
        MOD = $MOD$
        VAR = $VAR$
    }
}

sakuya_b3_character_self_clear_modifier_effect = {
    root = {
        remove_variable = $VAR$
    }
    remove_modifier = $MOD$
}

sakuya_b3_apply_marked_character_modifier_delta_effect = {
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_character_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope = {
            sakuya_b3_character_self_change_modifier_delta_effect = {
                MOD = $MOD$
                VAR = $VAR$
                DELTA = $DELTA$
            }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
}

sakuya_b3_clear_marked_character_modifier_effect = {
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_character_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope = {
            sakuya_b3_character_self_clear_modifier_effect = {
                MOD = $MOD$
                VAR = $VAR$
            }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
}

sakuya_b3_fx_transfer_marked_character_effect = {
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_character_effect = yes
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope = {
            transfer_character = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
        }
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found

sakuya_b3r_change_marked_character_interest_group_effect = {
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_character_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
            calc_true_if = {
                amount = 1
                has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_armed_forces
                has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_devout
                has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_industrialists
                has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_intelligentsia
                has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_landowners
                has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_petty_bourgeoisie
                has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_rural_folk
                has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_trade_unions
            }
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope.owner = {
            scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope = {
                if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_armed_forces } }
                    set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_armed_forces
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_devout } }
                    set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_devout
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_industrialists } }
                    set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_industrialists
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_intelligentsia } }
                    set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_intelligentsia
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_landowners } }
                    set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_landowners
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_petty_bourgeoisie } }
                    set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_rural_folk } }
                    set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_rural_folk
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { root = { has_variable = sakuya_b5_sel_ig_trade_unions } }
                    set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_trade_unions
                }
            }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
}

sakuya_b3_unify_player_character_ideology_to_ruler_effect = {
    ruler = { ideology = { save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_ruler_ideology_scope } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:sakuya_b3_ruler_ideology_scope }
        every_scope_character = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_ideology = scope:sakuya_b3_ruler_ideology_scope } }
            set_ideology = scope:sakuya_b3_ruler_ideology_scope
        }
    }
}

                    }

                        limit = {
                            interest_group = {
                                is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_intelligentsia

                        set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_intelligentsia
                    }
                    else_if = {

                                is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_landowners
                            }
                        }
                        transfer_character = root
                        set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_landowners

                        limit = {
                            interest_group = {
                                is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie

                        }
                        transfer_character = root
                        set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_rural_folk

                    else_if = {
                        limit = {

        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = {
            scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope = {
                if = {
                    limit = { owner ?= PREV }
                }
                else = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { exists = interest_group }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                interest_group = {
                                    is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_armed_forces
                                }
                            }
                            transfer_character = PREV
                            set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_armed_forces
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                interest_group = {
                                    is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_devout
                                }
                            }
                            transfer_character = PREV
                            set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_devout
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                interest_group = {
                                    is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_industrialists
                                }
                            }
                            transfer_character = PREV
                            set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_industrialists
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                interest_group = {
                                    is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_intelligentsia
                                }
                            }
                            transfer_character = PREV
                            set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_intelligentsia
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                interest_group = {
                                    is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_landowners
                                }
                            }
                            transfer_character = PREV
                            set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_landowners
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                interest_group = {
                                    is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
                                }
                            }
                            transfer_character = PREV
                            set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                interest_group = {
                                    is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_rural_folk
                                }
                            }
                            transfer_character = PREV
                            set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_rural_folk
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = {
                                interest_group = {
                                    is_same_interest_group_type = ig:ig_trade_unions
                                }
                            }
                            transfer_character = PREV
                            set_interest_group = PREV.ig:ig_trade_unions
                        }
                        else = {
                            transfer_character = PREV
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        transfer_character = PREV
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_role = character_role_agitator }
                    remove_character_role = character_role_agitator
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_role = character_role_general }
                    remove_character_role = character_role_general
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_role = character_role_admiral }
                    remove_character_role = character_role_admiral
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_role = character_role_politician } }
                    add_character_role = character_role_politician
                }
            }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
}

sakuya_b3r_set_marked_character_as_heir_of_player_effect = {
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_character_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
            exists = ruler
            OR = {
                has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
                has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
            }
        }
        set_heir = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
}

sakuya_b3r_set_marked_character_as_heir_of_marked_country_effect = {

    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_country_effect = yes

        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope
            scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = {
                exists = ruler
                OR = {
                    has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
                    has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
                }
            }
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_country_scope = {
            set_heir = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
        }
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_country_found
}

sakuya_b3r_change_marked_character_culture_to_player_primary_effect = {
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3r_primary_culture_found
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_character_effect = yes
    every_primary_culture = {
        limit = { root = { NOT = { has_variable = sakuya_b3r_primary_culture_found } } }
        save_scope_as = sakuya_b3r_primary_culture_scope
        root = { set_variable = sakuya_b3r_primary_culture_found }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
            has_variable = sakuya_b3r_primary_culture_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3r_primary_culture_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope = {
            change_character_culture = scope:sakuya_b3r_primary_culture_scope
        }
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3r_primary_culture_found
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
}

sakuya_b3r_popularity_clear_effect = { sakuya_b3_clear_marked_character_modifier_effect = { MOD = sakuya_cheat_b3_role_popularity VAR = sakuya_b3_role_popularity_value } }
sakuya_b3r_prominence_delta_effect = { sakuya_b3_apply_marked_character_modifier_delta_effect = { MOD = sakuya_cheat_b3_role_prominence VAR = sakuya_b3_role_prominence_value DELTA = $DELTA$ } }
sakuya_b3r_prominence_clear_effect = {
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_role_prominence_value
    sakuya_b3_resolve_marked_character_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
            exists = scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope
        }
        scope:sakuya_b3_marked_character_scope = {
            remove_modifier = sakuya_cheat_b3_role_prominence
            remove_variable = sakuya_b3_role_prominence_value
        }
    }
    else = {
        every_country = {
            every_scope_character = {
                remove_modifier = sakuya_cheat_b3_role_prominence
                remove_variable = sakuya_b3_role_prominence_value
            }
        }
        every_character_in_exile_pool = {
            remove_modifier = sakuya_cheat_b3_role_prominence
            remove_variable = sakuya_b3_role_prominence_value
        }
    }
    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_character_found
}

# === B3 GOODS BUILD BUILDING MODIFIERS BEGIN ===
sakuya_b3_apply_modifier_to_player_marked_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state } }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = $BUILDING$ }
				remove_modifier = $OLD_MOD$
				remove_modifier = $MOD1$
				remove_modifier = $MOD2$
				remove_modifier = $MOD3$
				remove_modifier = $MOD4$
				add_modifier = { name = $MOD$ days = -1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b3_clear_modifier_from_player_marked_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state } }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = $BUILDING$ }
				remove_modifier = $OLD_MOD$
				remove_modifier = $MOD1$
				remove_modifier = $MOD2$
				remove_modifier = $MOD3$
				remove_modifier = $MOD4$
			}
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b3_fill_marked_building_cash_reserves_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state any_scope_building = { is_building_type = $BUILDING$ } } }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state any_scope_building = { is_building_type = $BUILDING$ } }
			create_building = { building = $BUILDING$ level = 1 reserves = $RESERVES$ }
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b3_apply_modifier_to_player_marked_states_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state } }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			remove_modifier = $OLD_MOD$
			remove_modifier = $MOD1$
			remove_modifier = $MOD2$
			remove_modifier = $MOD3$
			remove_modifier = $MOD4$
			add_modifier = { name = $MOD$ days = -1 }
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b3_clear_modifier_from_player_marked_states_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state } }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			remove_modifier = $OLD_MOD$
			remove_modifier = $MOD1$
			remove_modifier = $MOD2$
			remove_modifier = $MOD3$
			remove_modifier = $MOD4$
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b6_add_stacking_modifier_to_player_marked_buildings_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_scope_state = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state } }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state }
			every_scope_building = {
				limit = { is_building_type = $BUILDING$ }
				remove_modifier = $OLD_MOD$
				remove_modifier = $OLD1$
				remove_modifier = $OLD2$
				remove_modifier = $OLD3$
				remove_modifier = $OLD4$

				if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_modifier = $C1A$ has_modifier = $C1B$ has_modifier = $C1C$ has_modifier = $C1D$ has_modifier = $C1E$ } } } add_modifier = { name = $ADD1$ days = -1 } }

				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_modifier = $C2A$ has_modifier = $C2B$ has_modifier = $C2C$ has_modifier = $C2D$ has_modifier = $C2E$ } } } add_modifier = { name = $ADD2$ days = -1 } }

				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_modifier = $C3A$ has_modifier = $C3B$ has_modifier = $C3C$ has_modifier = $C3D$ has_modifier = $C3E$ } } } add_modifier = { name = $ADD3$ days = -1 } }

				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_modifier = $C4A$ has_modifier = $C4B$ has_modifier = $C4C$ has_modifier = $C4D$ has_modifier = $C4E$ } } } add_modifier = { name = $ADD4$ days = -1 } }

				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_modifier = $C5A$ has_modifier = $C5B$ has_modifier = $C5C$ has_modifier = $C5D$ has_modifier = $C5E$ } } } add_modifier = { name = $ADD5$ days = -1 } }

				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_modifier = $C6A$ has_modifier = $C6B$ has_modifier = $C6C$ has_modifier = $C6D$ has_modifier = $C6E$ } } } add_modifier = { name = $ADD6$ days = -1 } }

				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_modifier = $C7A$ has_modifier = $C7B$ has_modifier = $C7C$ has_modifier = $C7D$ has_modifier = $C7E$ } } } add_modifier = { name = $ADD7$ days = -1 } }

    remove_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_company_found

        every_company = {
            limit = { has_variable = sakuya_main_03_01_marked }
            save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_marked_company_scope
            root = { set_variable = sakuya_b3_marked_company_found }
        }
    }
}

sakuya_b3_goods_resolve_selected_culture_effect = {
	clear_saved_scope = sakuya_b3_goods_selected_culture_scope
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sakuya_list_confirmed_culture }
		var:sakuya_list_confirmed_culture = {
			save_scope_as = sakuya_b3_goods_selected_culture_scope
		}
	}
}

sakuya_b3_goods_selected_culture_add_obsession_effect = {
	sakuya_b3_goods_resolve_selected_culture_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_b3_sel_good_ammunition } sakuya_b3_goods_selected_culture_add_obsession_good_effect = { GOOD = ammunition } }
